# Sathtek (سطحتك)

> Sathtek is a Saudi on-demand app for tow trucks (سطحة) and roadside assistance. A customer sends one request; it reaches every verified driver nearby, who each send a price offer. The customer compares offers, picks one, and tracks the tow live on a map. Operates 24/7 across Saudi Arabia, with requests currently centered on Riyadh.

## Key facts
- Brand: Sathtek / سطحتك (codename: Mankha)
- Service: tow truck dispatch, roadside assistance, car towing, battery replacement
- Country: Saudi Arabia (Arabic-first; English supported)
- Cities served: Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Khobar, Makkah, Madinah, Taif, Abha, Buraidah
- Availability: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
- Pricing: no fixed price — drivers send offers, the customer chooses; payment is electronic in-app
- Drivers: free to register (0 SAR), set their own price, get requests via WhatsApp, approval within 24 hours
